name: Bastion
concept: The Sentinel: a Counter on every Pressure and blocks that win the next round too. Repulse (his own Guard) Staggers a Pressure it beats; Rim Shot ends his Pressure combos and Shoulder Ram into Shield Slam is his Break line. Specials: Shield Rush, Aegis (a Guard that knocks down) and Battering Ram (a quick guard break). Super: Final Bastion, a Guard that leaves them Dizzy.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Repulse
cards.flavour: Turn the blow aside and step in.

cards.name: Aegis
cards.flavour: Plant the shield: whatever hits it goes down.

cards.name: Battering Ram
cards.flavour: A wall can move: straight through a turtle.

super.name: Final Bastion
super.flavour: Once a game: the wall that leaves them reeling.

notes: 10 Nov (afternoon, Mark): heat is renamed Charge (the page's words only), so Shield Charge is now Battering Ram, the same card. v21 (10 November 2026, Mark): HP 23 (v20 22) after the first round-robin. nine Guards (Recall x3, Read x3 and the fighter's own Guard x3, which pays out only if it beats a Pressure), two Guards do nothing, a 28-card deck, and three specials on the table, one of each type (the Super is whichever type suits the fighter). Repulse x3 (from x1). v20, 9 Nov (evening, Mark): the round's heat stops at the cap (no damage at max), so every HP is lower again to keep games the same length: HP 22 (first pass 26). v20 first balance pass (9 Nov): HP 26 (v19 36), heat cap 8 (v19 6). Under heat a low cap is offence (you reach max sooner, then every Pressure and the round's heat land as damage, and the Super is cheaper), so the v19 caps, set as defence, flipped the balance (Vex and Bastion about 67%, Atlas 31%); every HP is lower to bring time-outs down. v20 (9 November 2026, Mark): heat. Tokens are your fighter powering up: your heat (the grey your Pressures build) is yours, stops at your own cap of 6, and past it lands as straight damage; a Break that beats a Guard spends it all; a Guard that beats your Pressure douses it. No meter: specials cost 3 heat and the Super your whole cap, bought at the end of a round. The core is Recall x3 and Read x3 (Charge gone); one more card of the fighter's own to stay at 26: Sonic Cutter x3 (another Safe Counter, for a counter-puncher). Otherwise as v19. v19 (8 November 2026, night): two combo lines (Mark): a combo continues only with cards of its Starter's type; grabs stay out of combos except the Warden's. Convert line: Shoulder Ram (Starter) into Shield Slam (Ender); Lockdown is a grab, so not in it. v19 (8 November 2026, evening): the overflow grey cap (the pile stops at the cap, grey beyond it is lost as HP) and a Convert cashes only as the clash card, so no Convert is a Linker or Ender (Mark). Every HP 2 lower to bring time-outs back into the band. Shoulder Ram and Shield Slam lose Ender, so Rim Shot gains it (x3, from x2); Repulse x1 (from x2), so 8 Guards. His own grey cap: 6 (his mirror timed out 24-54% without it, 8% with). HP 36. v19 tuning: HP 38. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Edge Jab, Sonic Cutter gain it. Rules v18, 8 November 2026 (afternoon), Mark: better attacks, Knockdown on Lockdown (throws usually knock down) and HP 36. Edge Jab 17, Shield Bash 15 (Starter, Linker, Counter), Rim Shot 14 (Build 4, chip 1); Lockdown On hit: Knockdown. Against the 7 November Benchmark: 52.8% (54.0%, 51.6%; two seeds of 400); 45.2% without the speed changes (variants/bastion-36-attacks.json). As drafted that morning (HP 32): about 30%, variants/bastion-as-drafted.json.
